corpora.title: Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services
corpora.vintage_status: Four matching archived monthly release vintages
corpora.data_level: Published survey estimates; not respondent transactions
required_capabilities: Census multi-sheet table mapping and USD unit scaling
Adjustment basis and preliminary/revised value identities
Suppressed and unavailable cells distinct from zero
limitations: Tables are published estimates, not raw survey microdata, so these pairs cannot independently validate Census sampling estimators, response weighting or seasonal-adjustment algorithms.
A single workbook does not include all six level months needed to recompute its rolling-three-month year-on-year headline. That claim is directly published in Table2 H15.
Reports and tables overlap: independent arithmetic checks should compute from Table1 levels, not count copying Table2 output as independent formula validation.
Public reports could be memorized by a language model; use hidden future periods plus counterfactual input mutations to demonstrate dependence on supplied data.
Current Report Foundry posted-EUR transaction adapter is a different contract. No claim is made that these workbooks can currently generate a full Census report.
May–August were selected after the April25,2025 annual revision/restatement; earlier-vintage cases would additionally test the NAICS/employer-only scope transition.

rights_and_access.public_downloads: The agency publishes these reports and tables openly without credentials.
rights_and_access.source_attribution: Credit the U.S. Census Bureau for the original data and distinguish our derived analysis; the agency states conclusions are the performing party's responsibility.
rights_and_access.copyright_caveat: Census policy says employee-created works generally lack US copyright protection, but foreign-country and nonemployee-work rights can differ. This is not a claim that every logo or third-party element is unrestricted worldwide.

Quarter-scoped views of annual source workbook
limitations: Container grand totals do not exactly reproduce from rounded-looking published integer categories/rows. Discrepancies retained, no tolerance silently applied; cause unconfirmed.
Tonnage US-port and carrier aggregation matches both PDF totals exactly in each quarter.
